observation_storage: Browser/App memory only; uncertainty survives tab navigation, not page reload. These are not new task, workflow or execution database enum values.
unknown_resolution: Clear the App warning only when a later read of the bound task contains its persistent workflow. Absence of a workflow never proves failure or authorizes a retry.
preflight: task.status = AUTHORIZED and request task_id equals stored task/root task_id
exactly one schema-valid stored ROOT, matching projected hash and signature validity
stored task tenant, quota and expiry equal ROOT bindings
root not revoked and not_before <= server_time < root/task expires_at
no previous workflow, execution, refund or notification in the read projection
runtime profile available; cloud explicitly confirmed and within synthetic scope
write_boundary: Read root/task; submit one workflow. Do not create/authorize a task, allocate new credential budgets, execute a tool, or reset a previous run.
concurrency_boundary: Preflight is non-atomic. Existing unique workflow task_id prevents two persistent workflow runs; delegation/Gateway/Tool remain the authorization and effect barriers.
unknown_result_boundary: No automatic retry or resume from uncertain submission, QUEUED, RUNNING or derived INTERRUPTED; inspect durable evidence first.
existing_root_governance: Enabling coauthorization does not retroactively revoke an already issued base root or prove that root had two approvers.
